job.description:
Lead. Transform. Grow. 
This is a pivotal executive role for an experienced hospitality leader who can operate at both strategic and hands-on levels — owning group-wide performance, building high-performing leadership teams, strengthening operational disciplines and creating the platform for significant future growth.
With responsibility across a diverse portfolio incorporating food & beverage, accommodation, events and destination assets, the successful candidate will have genuine accountability for the commercial performance of the hospitality business and will play a key role in shaping its next phase of growth.

THE ROLE
Reporting to the Group Principal, the Group Managing Director will have single-point accountability for the commercial and operational performance of the hospitality portfolio, with responsibility for delivering sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth while protecting the quality and identity of each individual asset.
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Own the consolidated hospitality P&L, including revenue, gross margin, labour, controllable costs and EBITDA across the portfolio.
  • Lead annual budgeting and rolling forecasting in partnership with the Group CFO, ensuring venue leadership is accountable for performance.
  • Drive revenue growth through pricing, yield, distribution, events, membership, covers, average spend and non-room revenue.
  • Identify and deliver EBITDA improvement through labour productivity, cost control, procurement leverage and optimisation of underperforming revenue streams.
  • Establish consistent group-wide reporting, trading reviews and performance disciplines.
  • Build, assess and develop the senior leadership team, creating greater depth, accountability and succession capability.
  • Design and implement the organisational structure and operating rhythm required to support a materially larger portfolio.
  • Define and enforce group operating standards while retaining the individual character and identity of each asset.
  • Champion exceptional product, service and guest experience while ensuring robust compliance across liquor, food safety, WHS, employment and licensing requirements.
  • Lead major repositioning projects as an operational turnaround, separate from its redevelopment.
  • Provide operational and commercial leadership into future development, acquisition and partnership opportunities.
  • Lead pre-opening strategy, operating models, budgets, critical paths and leadership recruitment for new assets.
  • Ensure future growth is accretive rather than dilutive, supported by the right systems, people, structures and commercial disciplines.
  • Provide the Group Principal and CFO with a reliable, forward-looking view of performance, risks and opportunities.
  • Represent the Group with key industry, government, media and community stakeholders.
WHAT YOU WILL BRING
We are seeking a proven hospitality executive with the commercial maturity and operational credibility to lead a significant and growing portfolio.
You will ideally bring:
  • Multi-site hospitality leadership with full P&L responsibility across a portfolio generating approximately $75m–$150m+ in revenue.
  • Genuine, hands-on food & beverage expertise spanning restaurants, bars and events.
  • Strong hotel and accommodation experience, including rooms revenue management, pricing and distribution.
  • Exceptional commercial and financial acumen, with a strong understanding of unit economics, labour modelling, contribution analysis, EBITDA and capital returns.
  • A demonstrated history of delivering measurable revenue and EBITDA improvement, with the ability to clearly articulate how results were achieved.
  • Experience contributing to new developments, acquisitions or pre-openings, ideally within resort, destination or complex hospitality environments.
  • A strong track record of building, upgrading and holding leadership teams accountable.
  • The ability to balance strategic thinking with a willingness to get close to the operation when required.
YOUR LEADERSHIP STYLE
This role will suit an executive who is:
Low ego. High standards. Commercially sharp. Direct. Resilient.
You will be comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities can evolve, decisions need to be made quickly and effective teamwork is required.
You will bring confidence without arrogance, challenge constructively, communicate directly and create accountability without creating bureaucracy.
Most importantly, you will be a builder — someone who can take a successful but evolving hospitality business, strengthen its foundations and create the people, systems and commercial platform required to take it to the next level.

STRONGLY PREFERRED
  • Development and pre-opening experience, ideally including a resort or destination asset. Concept-to-opening exposure is more valuable here than any single operating credential.
  • Luxury or premium positioning experience where brand integrity constrains commercial decisions.
  • Regional or destination market experience.
  • Exposure to membership, club or subscription revenue models.
THE OPPORTUNITY
This is not simply an opportunity to manage an existing portfolio.
It is an opportunity to shape the future of a hospitality group, influence its investment and development pipeline, build a high-performing executive team and play a defining role in materially increasing the scale and value of the business.
If you are an accomplished hospitality executive ready to take genuine ownership of a growing portfolio and have the commercial capability, leadership depth and operational credibility to make a significant impact, we would like to hear from you.
